summary: The user reported having approximately 230000 dollars in crypto inaccessible through Cryptomus and receiving no resolution after contacting support for several weeks. The incident text does not establish whether the amount represents deposited funds or displayed account value.
user_mistake: placed substantial crypto holdings with a platform without retaining independent custody
prevention: Withdraw substantial crypto holdings to a self controlled wallet instead of leaving them on a platform / Stop depositing additional funds while existing assets remain inaccessible
classification_warning: insufficient detail to confirm intentional scam
